abstract: Pancreatic cancer is a highly immunosuppressive "cold" tumor that typically fails to achieve satisfactory immunotherapy outcomes. Photoimmunotherapy represents a preeminent cancer treatment strategy that combines the advantages of noninvasive phototherapy and drug-free immunotherapy. However, recently reported phototherapeutic materials predominantly respond to visible light via the oxygen-dependent pathway, severely weakening their efficacy in hypoxic and deep-seated tumors. Herein, a dimerization strategy for a near-infrared II (NIR-II)-emissive luminophore is developed for efficient image-guided photoimmunotherapy of "cold" pancreatic tumors. Owing to their dimeric design, the nanoparticles (NPs) of the dimeric luminophore (d-NBT) exhibited improved absorption and NIR-II fluorescence emission, along with efficient type-I reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation and sufficient photothermal conversion performance under 808 nm light irradiation. With NIR-II imaging, d-NBT NPs have been demonstrated to provide high-resolution whole-body angiography beyond 1500 nm and efficient tumor accumulation. The complete ablation of pancreatic tumors in primary and KPC tumor models were achieved via the photoimmunotherapy effect of d-NBT NPs. This study provides a dimerization strategy for high-performance NIR-II emissive luminophores for imaging-guided photoimmunotherapy of "cold" pancreatic cancer.
key_points_ko: d-NBT 나노입자는 808 nm 빛 조사 하에 효율적인 제1형 활성산소 생성과 광열 전환 성능을 보였습니다.
NIR-II 영상 유도를 통해 1500 nm 이상의 고해상도 전신 혈관조영과 효율적인 종양 축적이 확인되었습니다.
1차 및 KPC 췌장암 동물 모델에서 d-NBT 나노입자의 광면역치료 효과로 종양이 완전히 제거되었습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 면역반응이 낮은 췌장암을 치료하기 위해 근적외선-II(NIR-II) 발광 나노입자인 d-NBT를 개발했습니다. 이 나노입자는 808 nm 빛을 조사했을 때 활성산소(ROS)를 생성하고 광열 효과를 내어 종양을 제거합니다. 1차 및 KPC 췌장암 동물 모델에서 광면역치료 효과를 통해 종양이 완전 절제되었습니다. 이는 저산소 환경의 깊은 종양에서도 효과적인 고성능 근적외선-II 발광 물질의 전략을 제시합니다.
title: NIR-II emissive nanomedicine of dimer-structured conjugated oligomer induces immunogenic cell death for photoimmunotherapy of pancreatic cancer
title_ko: 이량체 구조의 공액 올리고머 기반 근적외선-II 발광 나노의약품을 통한 췌장암 광면역치료
